        v=ws[f'{col}{r}'].value
        if isinstance(v,(int,float)):
            val+=v*m
    total+=val
    c=ws[f'Q{r}']
    c.value=val
    f=c.font
    c.font=Font(bold=False, name=f.name, size=f.size, italic=f.italic, color=f.color)
ws['Q38'].value=total
f=ws['Q38'].font

wb.save(out)
